name: iBank IT team
about: 11 people of a bank's IT department in 7 teams, their Jira tasks (severity, estimate, due date, dependencies) and two weeks of Outlook meetings. Dates are relative: day 0 is the day you load it.

tasks.title: Hotfix: duplicate reversal of card refunds
tasks.description: Refunds were reversed twice when the acquirer retried the callback. Fixed and deployed.

tasks.title: Card authorisations time out at the lunch peak
tasks.description: p99 of the authorisation call to the processing centre is above 2 s between 12:00 and 14:00; 0.8% of card payments are declined. Suspect the connection pool to the HSM.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys for the outgoing transfer API
tasks.description: Mobile retries create duplicate SWIFT and local transfers when the network drops. Accept an Idempotency-Key header and store the first answer for 24 h.

tasks.title: Instant payments: move to ISO 20022 pacs.008
tasks.description: The national instant-payment scheme switches to ISO 20022 next quarter. Map our internal transfer to pacs.008 and handle pacs.002 status reports.

tasks.title: Partial refunds for e-commerce acquiring
tasks.description: Merchants ask to refund part of an order. Needs the idempotent transfer API first.

tasks.title: Rounding of AMD amounts on FX receipts
tasks.description: Receipts show 0.5 AMD differences after USD to AMD conversion; round half-even like the ledger.

tasks.title: Chargeback dashboard for card disputes
tasks.description: A Grafana board with open disputes by reason code and age.

tasks.title: Payments team capacity plan for Q4
tasks.description: Who works on what until the end of the year, holidays included.

tasks.title: Review the PAY-101 fix and write the post-mortem
tasks.description: Blameless post-mortem for the card authorisation incident, with actions and owners.

tasks.title: Prepare the processing-centre SLA renegotiation
tasks.description: Collect latency and availability numbers for the last 6 months before the vendor call.

tasks.title: Approve the Q4 release scope for payments
tasks.description: Agree with the product owner what goes into release 5.4 and what waits.

tasks.title: Statement PDF shows the wrong branch address
tasks.description: Fixed in the template.

tasks.title: Nightly interest accrual overruns the batch window
tasks.description: The accrual job ran until 07:40 twice this week; branches open at 09:00 with stale balances. Split the job by product and run the parts in parallel.

tasks.title: Early-withdrawal penalty wrong for 31-day months
tasks.description: Term-deposit penalties use 30-day months; customers who break a deposit on the 31st pay a day too much.

tasks.title: Loan repayment schedule API for the mobile app
tasks.description: An internal endpoint returning the schedule, paid and upcoming instalments of a loan.

tasks.title: Remove the deprecated SOAP balance endpoint
tasks.description: Nothing has called it for 90 days according to the gateway logs.

tasks.title: Unit tests for the mortgage refinancing calculator
tasks.description: The calculator has no tests and is about to change for the new rate table.

tasks.title: ISO 20022 fields in the payments ledger schema
tasks.description: New columns for end-to-end id, purpose code and structured remittance; a Flyway migration and a backfill.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL 17 upgrade rehearsal on the reporting replica
tasks.description: Run the upgrade on a copy, measure the downtime, write the runbook.

tasks.title: Account statement query takes over 5 s
tasks.description: Branch staff wait for statements; the query scans all transactions. Add an index on (account_id, booked_at).

tasks.title: Rotate the database credentials of core services
tasks.description: Quarterly rotation; this time through Vault dynamic secrets.

tasks.title: Archive closed accounts older than 10 years
tasks.description: Move them to the archive schema; keep them readable for audits.

tasks.title: Wrong currency symbol on the savings screen
tasks.description: Fixed in 5.3.2.

tasks.title: Login crashes on Android 15 after release 5.3
tasks.description: Crash rate 4% on Android 15 devices: the biometric prompt is created before the activity is ready.

tasks.title: Loan repayment schedule in the app
tasks.description: Show upcoming instalments with dates and amounts; uses the new core endpoint.

tasks.title: Freeze and unfreeze a card from the app
tasks.description: A toggle on the card screen; calls the card management API and confirms with biometrics.

tasks.title: Push notification for incoming transfers
tasks.description: Customers ask to be told when money arrives.

tasks.title: Contrast fixes from the accessibility audit
tasks.description: 11 screens fail WCAG AA contrast in dark mode.

tasks.title: Regression test pack for release 5.4
tasks.description: Full regression on iOS and Android before the go/no-go.

tasks.title: Automate the card-freeze UI tests
tasks.description: Espresso and XCUITest scenarios for freeze, unfreeze and the error paths.

tasks.title: Load test: salary-day traffic on the mobile API
tasks.description: Salary day brings 6x the usual logins between 10:00 and 12:00. Reproduce it in staging.

tasks.title: Triage open app-store reviews
tasks.description: 23 reviews without an answer; tag bugs, answer the rest.

tasks.title: Verify the Android 15 login fix on 12 devices
tasks.description: Device farm run plus two physical devices from the branch.

tasks.title: Disable TLS 1.0 on the legacy SMS gateway
tasks.description: Done after the vendor upgrade.

tasks.title: Patch the critical OpenSSL CVE on internet-facing gateways
tasks.description: Remote code execution, exploit published. Patch the API gateways and the internet-banking load balancers today.

tasks.title: Vault policy for the core database roles
tasks.description: Dynamic credentials for core services; needed before the quarterly rotation.

tasks.title: Pen-test finding: session fixation in internet banking
tasks.description: The session id is not renewed after login. Fix and ask the testers to retest.

tasks.title: Quarterly access review of privileged accounts
tasks.description: Every admin account confirmed by its manager; remove the rest.

tasks.title: Phishing simulation for branch staff
tasks.description: A campaign for 300 branch employees, with a short training for those who click.

tasks.title: AML reporting: the regulator's new XML schema
tasks.description: The Central Bank's new schema is mandatory from the 1st; validate our reports against it.

tasks.title: PCI DSS 4.0 evidence pack for the auditors
tasks.description: Collect evidence for requirements 3, 6, 8 and 10 before the audit kickoff.

tasks.title: Update the KYC procedure for remote onboarding
tasks.description: Video identification rules changed; legal reviews the draft.

tasks.title: Retention policy for call-centre recordings
tasks.description: How long recordings are kept and who may listen to them.

tasks.title: Sanctions screening: false-positive report
tasks.description: Why 40% of the hits last month were false positives, and which list rules to tune.

tasks.title: Credit-scoring model drift report
tasks.description: Population stability index and approval rates by segment for last month.

tasks.title: Duplicate transactions in the fraud-detection feed
tasks.description: The CDC connector replays a partition after restarts; the fraud engine sees transactions twice and blocks cards.

tasks.title: AML transaction extract for the regulator
tasks.description: Cash transactions above the threshold for the quarter, in the new format.

tasks.title: Move the risk dashboards to the new warehouse
tasks.description: Twelve dashboards still read the old warehouse.

tasks.title: Data-quality checks on loan applications
tasks.description: Income and employer fields are empty in 7% of applications from the partner channel.

tasks.title: Lineage of the capital adequacy report
tasks.description: Document which sources feed each line of the report.

tasks.title: Kafka cluster disks at 85%
tasks.description: Retention of the audit topics was never set; disks fill in about four days.

tasks.title: TLS certificate of the public API expires in 6 days
tasks.description: Renew through the CA and roll out to all gateway nodes.

tasks.title: Disaster-recovery drill for core banking
tasks.description: Fail over to the second data centre on a Saturday; the database part needs the upgrade rehearsal first.

tasks.title: Alert when the nightly batch overruns its window
tasks.description: Page the on-call engineer at 06:30 if the accrual job is still running.

tasks.title: Terraform modules for the new branch network
tasks.description: Eight new branches open next year.

tasks.title: Reduce the CI build time of the mobile app
tasks.description: Builds take 38 minutes; cache Gradle and CocoaPods.

tasks.title: Capacity plan for the salary-day peak
tasks.description: How many API and database nodes salary day needs, from the load test.

tasks.title: Q4 roadmap review with the business owners
tasks.description: Agree on priorities for cards, loans and the mobile app.

tasks.title: Release 5.4 go/no-go checklist
tasks.description: Sign-offs from QA, security and operations.

tasks.title: Weekly status report to the management board
tasks.description: Incidents, delivery, risks.

tasks.title: 2027 budget forecast for IT projects
tasks.description: Licences, hardware and contractors per project.
